tut.watch: Results appear in the feed as each part of the game is decided. Open Menu to try Speed x2, or Skip to the end.
tut.watch.arena: Your team is the circles. Both line-ups stay at the bottom. Open Menu to change the speed or skip to the end.
help.match.do: Tap View for Field, Action or All. Menu holds speed, pause, skip and sound. In Action, drag to look around.
